home.title: Turn on the camera and start your squat check
home.subtitle: Do a few squats and see depth, stability, and balance at a glance.
home.workspaceCopy: Focus on the squat, then get results and next-step guidance.
home.captureCopy: Stand a little back, turn sideways, and keep your full body in frame.
home.workflowStep1Copy: Keep your full body visible and start from a stable stance.
home.workflowStep2Copy: Move at your own pace while the system watches.
home.workflowStep3Copy: Get a quick summary and clear next steps right away.
home.insight1Desc: Stable lighting and a full-body view make the result more useful.
home.insight2Desc: Start with squat quality before adding more training goals.
home.insight3Desc: The most useful part is knowing what to change next.

assessment.title: Squat Check
assessment.subtitle: Turn on the camera, move, and see the result right away.
assessment.cameraStageCopy: Use good light and keep your full body in frame.
assessment.sessionStatusCopy: Framing looks good. You can start.
assessment.signalIdleDesc: Live assessment starts after the camera is turned on.
assessment.signalStartingDesc: Connecting to the camera and initializing tracking.
assessment.signalFramingDesc: Keep your full body visible. We will prompt you when it is time to move.
assessment.signalCapturingDesc: Tracking is ready. Begin moving now so the system can capture a full rep.
assessment.signalReadyDesc: This session has enough movement data. You can generate the result now.
assessment.signalErrorDesc: Restart the camera and try again.
assessment.statusFindBody: Stand in the center and keep your full body in frame.
assessment.statusDoOneRep: Complete at least one squat before generating a result.
assessment.statusReadyToScore: Movement captured. You can generate this result now.
assessment.sessionCopy: Pick a view, turn on the camera, and move naturally.
assessment.protocolCopy: Set up the shot first for a better result.
assessment.protocolStep1Copy: Keep your head, hips, knees, and ankles in frame.
assessment.protocolStep2Copy: Hold a stable stance for a moment before moving.
assessment.protocolStep3Copy: You do not need to rush. Consistency matters more.
assessment.liveMetricsCopy: We turn your motion into a simple live view of how you are moving.
assessment.qualityCopy: If the shot is not clear enough, we will ask you to adjust first.
assessment.qualityStep1Copy: If the lower body is hidden, the result will be less reliable.
assessment.qualityStep2Copy: Avoid switching between front and side view mid-session.
assessment.qualityStep3Copy: If the rhythm changes too much, we will show reminders first.
assessment.reviewCopy: See your movement summary, key flags, and next-step suggestions.
assessment.resultPendingNote: Turn on the camera and complete at least one squat to see your result here.
assessment.coachingCopy: These three habits usually make the result more stable.
assessment.coachingCard1Copy: Place the camera securely and keep only one person in frame.
assessment.coachingCard2Copy: A consistent squat makes the feedback more useful.
assessment.coachingCard3Copy: Check the summary first, then decide what to change next.
